La Bang-Bang

  • 1 1/2 oz Grey Goose® L'Orange vodka
  • 3 lemon wedges
  • 3 lime wedges
  • 1 orange wheel
  • 1/2 oz grenadine syrup
  • 2 oz ginger ale*

Muddle lime and lemon wedges with orange wheel in bottom of collins or tall glass. Fill glass with ice, then pour Grey Goose L'Orange Vodka over ice and muddled fruit. Add the ginger ale followed by grenadine and stir. Serve.

ELI5: How come I can't smell my snot when it's in my nose, but when I smell my finger after poking my nose there's a distinct "snotty" smell?

Have you ever sat on the toilet for a bit, finished your business, washed up (hopefully) and then returned to the bathroom a few minutes later to find out stinkier than you remember? This is because our brains react to constant exposure to a smell by not noticing it. As soon as we leave the area, or the smell ceases, out sensory perception "reboots," ready to be offended the next time it gets exposed. This is basically what is happening when your smell your finger.

PS. You should stop picking your nose.
